title: Direct final-residual observation on unchanged G21K solver paths

cross_validation.b1_note: The untouched-path maximum equals the G21K smallest event tolerance numerically, but G21K remains path-occluded because applying that tolerance changes backtracking from 8 to 2 before the convergence decision can be interpreted on the original path.

bounded_conclusions: The two representative adjacent-head failures are controlled by genuinely different residual predicates on their untouched solver paths.

At B1, the status-6 side fails because exactly one compartment residual exceeds the 1e-12 criterion: node 4 has +1.1378075673480759e-12. The adjacent status-0 side has maximum absolute compartment residual 9.495369239693498e-13 and no nonconverged balance compartment.

At B2, every individual compartment residual remains below 1e-12 on the status-6 side, but the total residual sum is -1.1858268037760853e-12 and therefore violates the total-balance criterion. The adjacent status-0 side has total residual -9.755467635457958e-13.
The B2 direct total residual equals the G21K smallest passing total tolerance exactly in binary64, independently cross-validating the path-preserving threshold tomography.

The B1 untouched maximum equals the G21K first event tolerance numerically. That does not make G21K path-preserving: changing CritDevBalCp at that value also changes the backtracking decision because the same quantity is used in the Fmax safeguard.
No head-change convergence criterion is active in any of the four direct snapshots, consistent with G21J.

The next question is numerical origin rather than criterion identity: determine how much of the B2 total sum is cancellation/order sensitive and decompose the B1 node-4 residual expression sufficiently to distinguish a real nonlinear residual difference from floating-point arithmetic near the absolute 1e-12 gate.
No production tolerance, retry policy, solver configuration, status smoothing, response-space globalization policy or HCOF/RHS behavior is changed or admitted.
next_natural_unit: Open G21M as residual arithmetic and cancellation qualification. Capture the full final residual vectors for the four G21L states through the same temporary research observer, compare native ordered SUM with independent exact-float/high-precision and compensated sums, and separately decompose the B1 node-4 residual terms on the untouched path before making any floating-point mechanism claim.
